title: Anti-Sidorenko orientations conjecture for trees
statement:
Let $T$ be an undirected tree, and call an orientation of $T$ **tournament anti-Sidorenko** when it has the tournament anti-Sidorenko property.

**Anti-Sidorenko orientations conjecture for trees.** For every undirected tree, there exists some orientation that has the tournament anti-Sidorenko property.
The paper says that this conjecture is affirmatively resolved for a special family of trees, while a complete characterization is not obtained; the general assertion therefore remains open.
source_name: Jacob Fox, Zoe Himwich, Nitya Mani and Yunkun Zhou, “Variations on Sidorenko's conjecture in tournaments”, arXiv:2402.08418 (2024).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.08418

Status: **open** according to the source (as of February 2024). “The general conjecture remains open, but a variety of special cases have been resolved.”
